spans.title: The Crate Came Alone
spans.blurb: A precious mummy case arrives without the assistant who guarded it across the sea. As an impatient professor pries off the lid, an old woman asks where her boy is.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals the murder discovery that launches the novel's mystery, though nothing of who did it or why.

spans.title: The Stag at Eve
spans.blurb: A stag wakes at dawn to hounds and horns on the mountain. The whole glen erupts as the chase sweeps past, then fades into silence.

spans.title: Fire in the Thatch
spans.blurb: Thatch blazes faster than water can touch it, and one man vanishes into the burning inn. Neighbors force the door against the flames to bring him out.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals that the inn burns down, an event the novel stages as a dramatic turn in its central mystery.

spans.title: The Marks Beside the Body
spans.blurb: A country doctor recounts the night he examined a dead man whose face was convulsed with fear, then lowers his voice to name what he found nearby.

spans.title: The Curse of the Baskervilles
spans.blurb: An old manuscript tells how a wicked squire carried off a farmer's daughter, and what came running over the moonlit moor on the night she fled.

books.pairNote: One is the ancient family legend and the other the modern death it haunts; they share no text and neither gives away the other's payoff.

spans.title: The Terrible Science
spans.blurb: Under the open night sky, a young astronomer argues that the stars offer not wonder but horror: sizes beyond awe, and lights already dying.

spans.title: Five Minutes to Eleven
spans.blurb: Two lovers slip into a near-empty church to be married in secret, fearing every passing glance. The parson is late, and she begins to read omens.
spans.spoilerNote: Shows that the astronomer and the lady marry in secret, a development the novel spends chapters building toward.

books.pairNote: A starlit conversation and a secret wedding from different stretches of the book; nothing shared, nothing deflated.

spans.title: The Genuine Mexican Plug
spans.blurb: A newcomer to a frontier town, dazzled by the local horsemanship, bids on an auction horse with one remarkable talent. A stranger's whisper closes the sale.

spans.title: The Bodymaster's Welcome
spans.blurb: A cocky newcomer elbows through a crowded saloon to introduce himself to its dangerous owner, and the interview swings from banter to a drawn revolver.

spans.title: First Night Out
spans.blurb: Fresh from prison, a quick-tongued schemer settles an old score on a dark pier, then climbs the stairs to dinner and finds a girl all grown up.

spans.title: Through the Zone of Fire
spans.blurb: Becalmed over dark villages as a tropical tempest gathers, three balloonists must choose: drop toward the trees or climb straight through the lightning.

spans.title: Voices in the Granite
spans.blurb: Lost in absolute darkness deep underground, a weakened wanderer presses his ear to the rock and catches what cannot possibly be there: words.
